fact.zh: 地球的天然卫星；继续靠近可以观察撞击地貌。
fact.en: Earth’s natural satellite; approach it to explore impact terrain.

fact.zh: 形状不规则，绕火星一周很快。
fact.en: An irregularly shaped moon with a short orbit around Mars.
A smaller, more distant moon of Mars.
Known for active volcanoes.

fact.zh: 冰壳下存在海洋的证据很强。
fact.en: Strong evidence supports an ocean beneath the ice shell.
The largest moon in the solar system.
Its surface is covered with ancient impact craters.

fact.zh: 有一个相对自身非常大的撞击坑。
fact.en: Has a very large crater relative to its own size.

fact.zh: 南极附近有水汽与冰粒喷流。
fact.en: Jets of water vapor and ice erupt near the south pole.
An icy moon with a vast canyon.
Bright ice cliffs mark its surface.

fact.zh: 布满撞击坑的冰质卫星。
fact.en: An icy moon covered with craters.

fact.zh: 浓厚大气下面有甲烷湖，可以继续靠近观察。
fact.en: A thick atmosphere hides methane lakes; approach for a closer view.
One hemisphere is much darker than the other.

fact.zh: 有复杂断崖和起伏地形。
fact.en: Has complex cliffs and varied terrain.
Canyons cut across its icy surface.
A relatively dark moon.
The largest moon of Uranus.
A large icy moon farther out.

fact.zh: 绕行方向与海王星自转相反。
fact.en: Orbits opposite to Neptune’s rotation.
